title: the band room Rising
author: Mara Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Iversen, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
